description: This file contains PHP classes for testing Markdown to Confluence conversion, including a mock engine, template, and PHPUnit test cases for Table of Contents behavior.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A simple mock engine that returns the 'content' key from data, simulating rendering behavior.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A template class extending HTML Template that provides an engine instance.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing Markdown to Confluence conversion, specifically testing Table of Contents insertion based on configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the 'content' key from the provided data array.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns an instance of the Engine class.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Creates a MainConfig instance, configures the template renderer, and returns it.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Tests that no TOC macro is added when auto_toc is not enabled.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Tests that a [TOC] token is replaced with a TOC macro.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Tests that a TOC macro is added automatically when auto_toc is enabled.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Tests that a TOC macro is not duplicated if a [TOC] token is already present.
